# 2026-10-15

## Color-first contrast: retire opaque plate repairs (Nifty `KB40!Jd3ls`)

- Task: user-reported rendering defects with screenshots (Harbor Glow acceptance run `38620904674`; Juniper Hearth live run): contrast repairs painted ugly opaque white/cream boxes around text, highlighted elements, and force-painted buttons. User approved the color-first direction: "changing the text's color directly" instead of boxes. Root-cause investigation followed the systematic-debugging skill; the design refinement used the retained Anthropic frontend-design skill.
- Root cause (evidence-backed): `scripts/run-creative-bakeoff.mjs` called the contrast sweep with `plates: allowContrastRepair` (default true), and `scripts/contrast-sweep.mjs` generated opaque plate rules per flagged element: `background-color` + `background-image:none` + `color` + `padding:.1em .35em` + `box-decoration-break:clone` + `z-index:3`, all `!important`, appended without replacing prior blocks. Verified in the delivered Harbor candidate CSS: 18 `box-decoration-break:clone` plate rules (including on `button` elements) and 5 duplicated marker blocks. The authoring contract (`creative-authoring-output.mjs` HERO MEDIA FOCUS CONTRACT, image-text rule, corrections-block description) and `docs/site-generation-guidelines.md` also mandated opaque "plate" treatment, so models authored their own boxes (Juniper hero).
- Change: contrast repairs are foreground-only (color / text-fill / outline). Plate planning, plate CSS generation, and the `plates` options were removed; the bakeoff no longer enables them; interactive controls are never painted. The managed `launchloom: bounded rendered contrast corrections` block is now rewritten in place (`withBoundedCorrections`) with accumulated repairs instead of appended, so repeated passes and repeated runs cannot stack duplicates. Authoring contract and guidelines were rewritten to foreground-first language: proving text color, soft scrim whose darkest text region passes, or a single deliberate surface field; per-line boxes, chips and control paint are explicitly prohibited as rendering defects. The dossier refiner's media-overlay snippet was updated and all 56 affected design briefs regenerated; the rendered-audit advisory message now suggests a proving foreground color, scrim or moved copy instead of a plate. `docs/plans/contrast-contract.md` carries a 2026-10-15 ruling amendment.
- Tests (TDD: rewrote five contrast-sweep tests plus a new legacy-block replacement test, watched them fail, then implemented): 587 tests pass across 11 affected suites (contrast-sweep, creative-authoring-output, creative-repair-loop, rendered-contrast, rendered-contrast-paint, static-homepage-contrast, publish-contrast-gate, color-contrast, refine-reference-design-prompts, provider-free-reference-integration, production-experience-author). `npm run check` 0 errors/0 warnings. Legacy callers passing the retired `plates` key are inert and covered by tests.
- Notes: existing shipped artifacts keep their old correction blocks until regenerated; new runs replace them. Ambiguous image/overlap backdrops continue to fail the deterministic gate and defer to bounded author repair, which is the designed path for tasteful solutions.
- Review fixes (CodeRabbit, 2 major findings, both verified against the code): `withBoundedCorrections` truncated everything after the first marker, so authored or revision CSS that followed a corrections block could be lost, and legacy blocks had no end marker. Fixed with explicit delimiters: `contrastRepairCss` now emits `/* launchloom: end bounded rendered contrast corrections */`; new `stripBoundedCorrections` removes delimited blocks precisely and, for legacy undelimited blocks, removes only the marker line plus contiguous lines matching the generated rule signatures (color, plate and pseudo shapes) while preserving all other CSS; `withBoundedCorrections` then appends the fresh block. Regression tests were written first and watched failing (authored CSS after a legacy block; authored CSS after a delimited block). Final: 13/13 contrast-sweep tests, 151/151 across the sweep/repair/render/static/publish sample, `astro check` 0 errors. The pre-fix head had full green CI (validate 6m59s, route-fixtures 12m49s); the review-fix head re-runs required checks before merge.
- Shipped: PR #174 merged as `fc0d7d5c` (squash) after exact-head green CI (`classify` 16s, `validate` 8m7s, `route-fixtures` 11m27s) and a zero-finding follow-up review of the fix commit. Main deploy run `38796084217` (head `fc0d7d5c`) completed **success** on GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-24.04`. Nifty `KB40!Jd3ls` completed with readback. Effect: new generations never receive boxed plate paint; corrections are foreground-only and self-replacing with authored CSS preserved before or after the block; guidance, authoring contracts and 56 regenerated briefs steer authors to proving text colors, soft scrims or moved copy fields instead of boxes.
- Worktree: `launchloom-contrast-color-first` on `codex/launchloom-contrast-color-first` from main `3d7961be`. The in-flight Juniper run (`38779046390`) was left untouched throughout, per the user.
